name: Josh Allen
notes: Rushing floor is the whole dynasty case at QB; that floor is also what ages first.

name: Jayden Daniels
notes: Dual-threat on a rookie contract — the archetype superflex leagues price highest.

name: Caleb Williams
notes: Draft capital plus age; value swings hardest on scheme and supporting cast.

name: Patrick Mahomes
notes: Elite production, shortening dynasty window. Classic sell-high-into-a-contender asset.

name: Bo Nix
notes: Startable superflex QB2 whose value is entirely format-dependent.

name: Bijan Robinson
notes: Three-down back with receiving work — the only RB profile worth cornerstone pricing.

name: Jahmyr Gibbs
notes: Receiving volume insulates him from the usual RB aging cliff.

name: Saquon Barkley
notes: Past the typical RB age curve. Production is real; the resale window is not.

name: De'Von Achane
notes: Efficiency-dependent profile; volume risk if the offense changes shape.

name: Ashton Jeanty
notes: First-round rookie capital at RB — the market prices this at its peak on day one.

name: Ja'Marr Chase
notes: Peak-age alpha WR. In dynasty this is the asset class you overpay for and keep.

name: Justin Jefferson
notes: Production independent of quarterback play — rare and worth a premium.

name: Malik Nabers
notes: Target share on a bad offense still compounds; age is doing the work here.

name: Nico Collins
notes: Late-breakout profile; the market discounts these relative to draft-capital darlings.

name: Brian Thomas Jr.
notes: Early production plus age — the two inputs that actually predict WR dynasty value.

name: Rome Odunze
notes: Draft capital without a target monopoly. A patience asset, not a producer yet.

name: Puka Nacua
notes: Volume-driven; the question is what the target share looks like post-Kupp era.

name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
notes: Pedigree buy-low candidate whenever the market reacts to a slow stretch.

name: Brock Bowers
notes: Young TEs who produce immediately are the scarcest asset in dynasty.

name: Trey McBride
notes: Reception volume at TE — worth more in TE-premium formats than the consensus rank.

name: Sam LaPorta
notes: Efficient in a crowded offense; touchdown variance drives most of his perceived value.

name: Brandon Aubrey
notes: Kickers are not dynasty assets. Roster one, never trade for one.

name: Denver Broncos D/ST
notes: Streaming asset. Age is a schema placeholder — team defenses do not have one.
